Owned CI/CD, Docker containerization and OpenTelemetry observability on AWS and Railway.
Owned the React app end to end: TanStack Query cache design, optimistic updates, SSR and hydration, accessible UI.

Re-platformed it in 2026 to static Astro on Cloudflare Workers: view transitions that morph the product photo into its page, prices re-checked on the server by an Effect checkout worker.
90+ Real Experience Score and steady organic SEO traffic (JSON-LD, sitemap, Google Merchant feed).
Optimized a multi-tenant system (React, Express, Firebase) serving 10,000+ active users.
Built internal Vue/NestJS tools and Chrome extensions used daily by the HR department.
